cards.name: Camp Opportunity
cards.description: Students explore a different career each day through hands-on activities. Listed subjects include healthcare, construction, culinary arts, science, agriculture and the arts.

transportation.text: Camp will begin each day at McDowell High School; transportation offered through an abbreviated bus route. Transportation to the off-site sessions will be provided.

cards.review_notes: 2026 dates are stated in official calendar search results. The undated program page states rising grades 7-9, McDowell County Public Schools eligibility, free admission, breakfast and snacks, and transportation; confirm these apply to 2026 or 2027. Price omitted because the free admission statement has no season year. Linked registration form is explicitly for 2025 and closed; this is not evidence that 2026 or 2027 registration is closed. Calendar venue address is 600 W Mc Dowell Jr High School Rd; school-published footer address, 600 McDowell High Drive, was used instead. McDowell Technical Community College and other locations are field-trip destinations, not additional drop-off sites.
